title: DaylightPaint Command
description: Replace the daylight overlay: delete forsk:kind=analysis objects, then add one welded vertex-coloured mesh (shared corner vertices) on A-ANALYSE. Display mode 'Forsk Analysis': mesh wires off, unlit vertex colours. The layer is off in every layout detail and does not print. Sky-vis proxy, not lux.

z.description: Mesh height in mm, usually the floor plus 50.

vertices.description: Cell corners [x, y] in mm, each once.

colors.description: One Planwire ramp colour per vertex.

faces.description: One quad of vertex indices per usable cell.
